name: Dialga
description: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed stat.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also paralyze the target.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.description: The foe is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the foe with huge, sharp claws.

moves.name: Roar of Time
moves.description: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Heal Block
moves.description: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a slash of claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sand storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock,  Ground, and Steel.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the foe with huge, sharp claws.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.
